checks: Spanish commands preserve spaces, accents, quoted names and distinguish bulk moves
Authorization only covers selected folders and can be revoked then restored for undo
Organization is preview-only until code and review, preserves subfolders and resolves duplicate names
Trash is a reversible move, survives restart and restores exact bytes
Explicit folders can move and trash without altering their contents
Renames never overwrite and searches include nested names but skip links and hidden data
Traversal, absolute paths, NTFS streams, symbolic links and system folders are rejected
Stale files, changed roots and newly occupied targets stop a prepared operation
Undo refuses modified destination bytes or occupied original names
Plans expire and a replayed confirmation never repeats a completed operation
A filesystem error returns completed moves, and an unsuccessful rollback is reported as partial
Batch limit avoids silently processing part of an oversized folder
An app extracted inside Downloads does not prevent authorizing Downloads, but app files stay protected
Cross-volume fallback makes an exclusive verified copy and preserves bytes through undo
A changed source during cross-volume copying is kept and the incomplete destination is removed
An interrupted journal is reported for manual review and never silently replays a move
Only installed local models are selectable; cloud-labelled models and missing models are rejected
Local model sees only the user request and folder aliases, and its response is a proposed structured action
Model output cannot authorize folders, execute code, confirm plans or introduce unknown fields
A model may not infer deletion from a vague cleanup request; unavailable or malformed responses keep files untouched
Loopback UI does not grant unauthenticated filesystem access; forged origins and hosts are rejected
HTTP command previews, explicit confirmation, cancellation and undo operate on synthetic files
Native speech events require the wake word, adequate confidence and the current confirmation code
Removing a folder invalidates the pending plan and prevents any later file access through its alias
Optional local AI prepares a normal reviewed plan and cannot confirm or delete from model instructions
Stopping recognition while its native process is starting kills the late process
Two start requests cannot leave a second microphone process running
Native recognition forwards data but errors do not leave microphone state active
Closing while speech output starts never reopens the microphone afterwards
Local session starts and removes the access token from the browser URL
Folder picking and explicit authorization add two synthetic local folders
The UI previews destinations, requires review and moves actual synthetic files only after confirmation
Undo is a separate reviewed plan that restores real file contents
Searching, recoverable trash and history persist through reload without losing session access
Synthetic native voice events prepare and confirm an undo through the real server and update microphone state
Untrusted filenames render as text rather than executable HTML
The Spanish interface and a full file-operation preview fit a 390px viewport
Optional Ollama configuration and a natural-language proposal use the reviewed file pipeline with a simulated local model
Cancelling a preview preserves files and the browser uses no external requests or APIs

testedHost: Linux; Chromium desktop and 390px viewport; synthetic temporary files only
windowsVoice: System.Speech native recognizer and synthesizer; Spanish recognizer installation required; adapter lifecycle and voice events tested with stubs
optionalLocalModel: Ollama at fixed http://127.0.0.1:11434, no redirects. No model bundled or downloaded automatically. Structured actions validated and reviewed; model cannot confirm or execute. Tests use simulated responses.
runtime: Official Node.js v24.22.2 Windows x64 ZIP, verified SHA-256 in runtime-manifest.json
network: Loopback-only authenticated API; browser made no external requests; no paid or cloud voice/AI API
limitations: Native speech, Windows launcher and a real local model must be checked on the user Windows computer.
Multi-file operations journal progress and attempt rollback; interrupted or partial jobs require reviewing recorded paths.
Full directories across volumes use Windows Explorer; individual files support verified cross-volume copy.
